headline: Chrome Archives the Modern Web Platform
lede: This curated guidance system gives coding agents a structured reference for contemporary HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and browser APIs. Its searchable guides and modernization scans steer generated code toward native capabilities, accessibility, performance, and reliable cross-browser behavior.

headline: Codex Security Turns Findings Into Fixes
lede: Codex Security moves repository analysis beyond alert generation: it investigates vulnerabilities, proposes patches, verifies remediation, and assigns ownership. CLI workflows, GitHub Actions, SARIF exports, and enterprise integrations make the security loop repeatable from diff to closure.

headline: nvm Keeps Every Node Version Within Reach
lede: nvm remains the rugged answer to Node.js version sprawl, letting each shell or project select its own runtime without administrator privileges. With aliases, `.nvmrc` files, offline installs, and CI guidance, the Bash utility keeps local machines and automation environments aligned.

headline: HermesEnabler Rewrites the Watch Face Rules
lede: HermesEnabler is a focused watchOS experiment that unlocks Hermès faces on unsupported Apple Watch models through sideloading and MobileGestalt changes. It is a hands-on customization project, complete with backup and restore safeguards—and compatibility limits that demand an experienced operator.

headline: Sure Rebuilds Personal Finance on Your Terms
lede: Sure carries the open-source spirit of Maybe Finance into a self-hostable platform for budgets, investments, and household wealth. Docker deployment, PostgreSQL, Redis, multiple clients, and optional AI keep sensitive financial workflows under the operator’s control.

headline: Qwen Code Builds a Team Around the Terminal
lede: Qwen Code treats software development as an orchestrated system of plans, tools, worktrees, subagents, and checkpoints. Its terminal, editor, web, SDK, and daemon interfaces let teams route the same agentic workflow across models, environments, and CI pipelines.

headline: TensorFold Runs Local Models Without Python
lede: TensorFold compresses local inference into a Zig binary with direct Metal, CUDA, and Vulkan paths for modern GPUs. OpenAI-compatible APIs, verified checkpoints, adjustable concurrency, and hardware-aware releases make its central question practical: how much model can the machine sustain?

headline: Node.js Keeps JavaScript Moving at Scale
lede: Node.js pairs V8 with event-driven, non-blocking I/O to power servers, command-line tools, automation, and an immense package ecosystem. Its release channels, native integrations, standard libraries, and long-term support make the runtime a durable foundation for concurrent network work.

headline: Agent Skills Gives Coding Agents a Playbook
lede: Agent Skills turns software practice into a sequence of explicit procedures: specify, plan, build, test, review, and ship. Its Markdown workflows encode quality gates and verification steps so autonomous execution follows a blueprint instead of improvising from a single prompt.

headline: Astryx Brings Meta-Scale React Components Into the Open
lede: Astryx packages more than 150 accessible React components for React 19 and StyleX, with themes, dark mode, templates, and a practical ejection path. Typed APIs, CSS custom properties, and flexible class overrides give product teams a polished visual system without locking them into a styling stack.
